# Interferon response summary (fabricated draft)

Differential expression analysis revealed coordinated activation of the type-I interferon program. IFI6 was downregulated in the treated arm (Table 1). ISG15 was decreased relative to control (Table 1). MX1 was reduced in IFN-treated PBMCs (Table 1).

In contrast, the proinflammatory cytokines TNF and IL6 were downregulated (Table 1). OAS1 was upregulated as expected (Table 1). STAT1 was upregulated in line with the canonical signaling cascade (Table 1).
